page.layout: One printed page of text in verse. A running head at the top, the page number at the upper right. Handwritten annotations in the right margin are not printed and are left out.

main_text.p: Verùm acie gladij damnanda Calumnia sæuî Quos ferit innocuos, scit penetrare magis. Syrenum Circéfque sonis plausúque suadet Blandiùs & leuiùs, credula corda mouens. Perforat igniuomis vehementiùs atra sagittis Immeritos, nulli parcere sueta bono. At modus est tandem, quo detestabile monstrum Vincatur telis non noceátue suis. Nil conscire sibi, vitiis procul omnibus ire, Infpectore frui, iudice, teste Deo: Cautibus est Iuræ clypeus securior: ictus Depellens linguæ, felláque dirá malæ. Sed ferit innocuos damnanda CALVMNIA sæuo. Ense magis, morsu vipereóque magis.
main_text.head: Πολυλογία inutilis.
main_text.p: Vicinis circùm non profunt murmura campis, Edita dum ftreperâ diffugit amnis aquâ. Non profunt vacuum iactata per aëra verba. Quæ bene vox mentes erudit, illa iuuat.
main_text.head: Pictor & Praco periti, parum pij.
main_text.p: Affabrè pingit pictoris dextra periti, Cuius mens pulchræ nil pietatis habet. Illum præco refert, pleno qui iactitat ore, In ficto quæ non pectore sacra gerit.
main_text.head: Ad illud Horatij. Inuolue te virtute tua.
main_text.p: Inuidiâ inuoluunt dum se plerumque maligni Artibus illaqueênt, vt perimántque suis: Te virtute inuolue tuâ: serpente profecta Cadmæo poterit nulla nocere cohors.

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations on the right and at the foot are manuscript, not printed, and are omitted. Several words in the verse are doubtful at the scan's edges (for example "noceátue", "iuuat", "illaqueênt"); they are copied as they appear.
